# Height Comparison Tool

> Free online visual height comparison tool, child height potential calculator, and interactive growth exercises.

## Core Features
- Dynamic visual scaling ruler (0 - 40m+) with dual Metric (cm) and Imperial (ft/in) support.
- Real-time Wikipedia API celebrity search with debounced fetching.
- Child Mid-Parental Potential Height Calculator (Tanner formula).
- 10 Interactive 2D animated growth exercises.

## Pages
- Home (Visual Comparison Tool): /#home
- Child Potential Height Calculator: /#calculator
- 2D Animated Growth Exercises: /#exercises
- Celebrity Heights Library: /#celebrities

## Pricing & Policies
- Price: Free ($0 USD). No subscriptions, plans, or signups required.
- Refund & Cancellation Policy: Not applicable. The tool is 100% free with no hidden charges, paid plans, or billing.
- Data Privacy: 100% client-side execution. All data is processed in browser memory and never saved on external servers.

## Target Audience
- General public comparing heights of people, celebrities, or objects.
- Parents estimating a child's adult height using the mid-parental formula.
- Fitness enthusiasts performing daily growth and posture exercises.
- Students and researchers needing a quick height unit converter (cm to ft/in).

## Technical
- Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, and vanilla JS animations.
- 13 structured JSON-LD schemas for Google rich results: WebApplication, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, MedicalWebPage, 10x HowTo.
- Mobile-responsive, dark theme matching heightcomparison.com aesthetic.
- No backend, no tracking, no cookies.
